{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Re-load the data
file_path = '/home/musel/Github/research_agent/data/sales.csv'
df = pd.read_csv(file_path)

# Clean the revenue column: remove commas and convert to float
df['revenue_clean'] = df['revenue'].str.replace(',', '').astype(float)

# Now, check for QA orders again using the clean revenue
df_qa = df[df['revenue_clean'] == 999999.99]
print(f"Number of QA orders (revenue_clean == 999999.99): {df_qa.shape[0]}")

# Remove QA orders
df_clean = df[~(df['revenue_clean'] == 999999.99)]

# Remove refunded orders
df_completed = df_clean[df_clean['status'] == 'completed']

# Check the final population
print(f"Final population (completed orders, no QA): {df_completed.shape[0]}")

# Check for -1 in customer_age
print(f"Number of rows with customer_age == -1: {df_completed[df_completed['customer_age'] == -1].shape[0]}")

# Display the first few rows of the cleaned data
print(df_completed[['channel', 'customer_segment', 'converted', 'customer_age']].head())"}
